stem: Why can a visually healthy donor plant not be assumed HLVd-free?
choices: Cannabis plants can carry HLVd without obvious symptoms, so visual inspection is not a reliable exclusion test.
HLVd always produces visible insects instead of symptoms.
Only flowering plants can be infected.
HLVd is detectable only after plants die.
rationale: Peer-reviewed cannabis literature documents asymptomatic HLVd infection, especially in stock/propagation contexts.
